BUILDPLAN.md T-22 (M4).

The copy freeze: every participant-facing string from `SPEC.md` §11 in one module; the forbidden-copy lint and the §11.1 trope check in `test`, the trope check failing the build on any match in the copy module (D-23)

Criteria: AC-98, AC-59, AC-42, G-5
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-05–07, T-12
BUILDPLAN notes: —

Orchestrator notes: Creates or completes `web/shared/copy` (F-11): serialized on `web/shared`. The forbidden list and the §11.1 patterns are SPEC §11's, verbatim.

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: ORCHESTRATOR note from PQ-4 (T-04a): the room's refusal reasons (409 bodies for illegal transitions and bounds) are API diagnostics, not §11 copy; PQ-4 kept them clear of the Forbidden patterns but they are not in copy.js. T-22's lint should decide whether server diagnostics are in scope and say so.

DISPATCHED PQ-27 2026-09-30 01:3x EDT by the Orchestrator: inline-full, surface:15 in pane:1, worktree /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/copy-freeze, branch ai-c11-cc/copy-freeze off origin/ai-c11-cc/a11y-sweep @ b0dda3e57702f835be9818a469b799dc609f0024 (PQ-16's PR #37, at review, not merged; base it, rebase before your first push only). Boot prompt at the worktree's .claude/boot-prompt.md (templates/gen-wave18.py). Rulings in the brief: one source for the Forbidden and section-11.1 patterns in JS with a stdlib Python twin pinned to one fixture set under bank/fixtures/copy-lint/; home.js PROPOSED strings and trace.js's two aria-labels move into the copy module under a marked PROPOSED-section-11 block with words unchanged (F-34, F-38 stay upstream); check_prose never raises - the review screen (T-18) renders its warnings later; no justfile edit (globs pick the suites up). Sibling PQ-26 (burst in CI) runs now off the same branch: you own web/shared/**, the copy tests, string moves in the JS surfaces, room/src/copy.rs, room/tests/twins.rs, pipeline copylint and its tests, bank/fixtures/copy-lint/**, web/shared/README.md. main moved to 1d721f4 (the client's PR #36, bank-only: q4/q7/q8 options re-authored) - bank prose changed, nothing in your files. Push and gh pr create are the client's Yes in your tab.
READY PQ-27 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/copy-freeze HEAD b0dda3e57702f835be9818a469b799dc609f0024 BASE b0dda3e57702f835be9818a469b799dc609f0024 MODE active

ORCHESTRATOR 01:4x: main is red on test-pipeline since the client's PR #36 (1d721f4: bank/questions q4/q7/q8 re-authored by hand; test_migration.py, test_fit.py, test_audit.py fail). Not your files and not your fault; PQ-38 repairs main. Expect your PR's just test job to fail on those pipeline tests until PQ-38 merges and you merge origin/main; judge your own suites locally (just test-room, just test-web, and for PQ-27 the pipeline tests you add) and say so in DONE. Do not touch bank/questions/** or the migration tests.

QUESTION PQ-27 (building on my side of each; none blocks the build). Q1 AC-59: the brief wants the released buzzer's 'Nothing about you was recorded.' served as a module key, but the client cut it at HC-0 (PQ-34, copy.test.js pins its absence) and SPEC 11 has no Buzzer-released row. I do not restore it; the test asserts what release does serve. AC-59 needs a decision before merge: amend AC-59 and its EVALUATION row, or restore a line through SPEC 11. Q2: host.js statusLine renders the room's 'reason' verbatim on the host phone (plus HTTP status text, exception text and close codes). Two reasons are 11 keys (the denials); others are diagnostics, e.g. phase.rs 'There is no room yet. Create a room comes first.'. The buzzer never renders a reason (proven by test). The host path is not changed, since it would be a behaviour change and a string to author; it is the freeze allowlist's one entry. Q3 PROPOSED-11 beyond F-34/F-38, found by the inventory and moved with words unchanged: trace.js traceSay '<name> is now <now>', check.js sr-only 'Correct', well.js default label 'Source code'. Each needs a SPEC 11 row. Q4: SPEC 11 runs the Forbidden lint over question prose with no stated consequence; check_prose reports those matches as warnings (group forbidden), never a failure. Should committed bank prose fail instead? Q5: trace step notes are participant-facing (read by the host, shown on the wall) but are not among SPEC 11's lint homes, so they are not linted.

ORCHESTRATOR rulings on your QUESTION (01:5x). Q1 AC-59: agreed - do not restore the line; the brief assumed a string the client cut at HC-0 (PQ-34), so the brief was wrong there. Your test asserts what release serves. The decision (amend AC-59 and its EVALUATION row, or restore a line through SPEC 11) is the client's; routed upstream as F-41 and put to the client. Record it under deviations. Q2: accepted as the freeze allowlist's one entry, justified as host-only diagnostics that never reach a participant device; add a read-only structural test in your own test file that no 'reason' string literal in room/src matches the Forbidden patterns (PQ-4 kept them clear by hand; make it a test; read room/src, edit nothing there - PQ-26 owns it). SPEC 11 has no row for the host's diagnostic line: F-42 upstream. Q3: accepted - move traceSay's step text, check.js's sr-only 'Correct' and well.js's 'Source code' under PROPOSED-11 with words unchanged; F-43 upstream, batched with F-34 and F-38 as the section-11 accessibility and trace strings. Q4: warnings, as you have it - section 11.1's prose tier is the organizer's decision at affirm, and the contract states no consequence for a Forbidden match in prose; F-44 upstream. Run check_prose over the committed bank once and put any matches in your DONE as information. Q5: include trace step notes in check_prose as a warning field (a superset of 11.1's three fields, warning tier only, no failure); record it as a deviation; F-45 upstream. None of these blocks you; carry on.

BLOCKED PQ-27 on commit signing: the third commit (web/test/copy-freeze.test.js, web/shared/README.md) is staged in /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/copy-freeze. The bypassed commit failed '1Password: agent returned an error', the retry failed 'failed to fill whole buffer', and the ssh-keygen fallback via the 1Password agent socket (ssh-add -l lists the signing key SHA256:ZmDAi3…) failed 'communication with agent failed'. Two earlier commits (9028042, 9c54c0a) signed fine 15 minutes ago. Not bypassing signing. Needs the client to unlock or approve in 1Password; I resume on word. Work state: all suites green locally (web 271/271 1.5 s, pipeline 629 passed 3.3 s via stand-in, twins 18/18).
UNBLOCKED PQ-27: signing works again after the client's retry; 8a16fc5 is signed (Good git signature). Moving on to code review.

CHECKPOINT PQ-27 (session usage limit reached; resume in a fresh session). HEAD 8a16fc5, 3 signed commits, not pushed. Green locally: web 271/271, pipeline 629 passed (stand-in interpreter), twins 18/18, canary 12/12 (run outside the sandbox; local port binding is off inside it). FINDING, needs the Orchestrator: just test-room has one failure, room/tests/wall_page.rs:210 every_shared_file_and_font_serves_with_its_bytes_and_type: /shared/copylint.js returns 404, because the room serves web/shared from its own list. copylint.js is test-only; no page loads it. Fixing it means touching room/** (PQ-26's) or moving the module out of web/shared, against the brief. Which do you want? Still to do: the Sonnet code review verdict (it was running when the session stopped; re-run it on 8a16fc5), fix that failure per your ruling, validation note, push, PR against main, attach, status review, DONE comment.

ORCHESTRATOR ruling on your FINDING (03:5x): move the module out of web/shared - the room's test is right that web/shared holds only what pages load, and copylint.js is test-only. Put it at web/test/copylint.js (not *.test.js, so the runner glob skips it, the _load.js precedent) or another non-served path you prefer; load it from there in your suites; the Python twin and the fixture set stay where they are. room/** stays untouched (PQ-26's), the brief's 'say web/shared/copylint.js' was a suggestion, not a requirement - record the move under deviations. Then: re-run the Sonnet code review on your head, validation note, push, PR against main with the 'Based on #37' line, attach, status review, DONE. Signing is back (the Orchestrator's board commit signed at 03:51).
